WR(CR) Concentric Internal Retaining Ring for Bore

A concentric-type internal (C-shape) retaining ring installed inside a bore. Unlike a standard C-type (R-type) ring, the ring itself is machined into a perfectly circular (concentric) shape, so once seated in the groove its center stays true and it distributes load evenly. The spec code is WR(CR).
